name: Sagebrush Cantina Restaurant & Saloon
bio: Sagebrush Cantina is a Mexican-American restaurant and saloon in Old Town Calabasas, open since 1974. It hosts live bands, solo acoustic performers, DJs and karaoke nights, with mariachi music at Sunday brunch.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from sagebrushcantina.com and the Sagebrush Cantina Facebook.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
